panelIntro: All these settings are yours. Reminders cannot be turned off, but their frequency can be set.
onBreak: You are on a break until {until}. New rounds are unavailable during a break; free rewards can still be claimed.
reminderHint: Appears when session length reaches this multiple.
dailyLimitHint: Once reached, new rounds stop until tomorrow.
cooldownHint: A short pause before the next round.
breakHint: A break never penalises you: missions, rewards and badges are unaffected.
